summary: This is a Docker Compose configuration file that defines a single service called 'heimdall', which is a web-based application dashboard. It specifies the container image to use, sets up environment variables for user permissions and timezone, mounts a local config directory into the container, exposes ports for HTTP and HTTPS traffic, and configures the container to automatically restart if it stops unexpectedly.

explanations.1: This comment tells spell-checkers to ignore spelling errors in this file, since YAML configuration files often contain technical terms that aren't in standard dictionaries.
explanations.9: PUID sets the user ID that the container process runs as; the ${USER_ID:-1000} syntax means 'use the USER_ID variable if it's defined, otherwise default to 1000'.
explanations.10: PGID does the same thing for the group ID, allowing the container to have the same file permissions as the host system.
explanations.13: This mounts the ./config folder from your computer into the /config folder inside the container, so configuration changes persist even if the container is recreated.
explanations.15: %%port=80%% is a template variable that will be replaced with an actual port number when this file is processed; it maps that external port to port 80 inside the container.
